research_question: Which 10 of 904 candidate rice lines are most likely to fall in the high-GRWT100 quartile?
uncertainty: held-out pool Spearman 0.454 (from model card); predictions are model outputs in grams/100-grain scale but are NOT measurements
conclusion: All 904 candidates scored; ranking is strictly decreasing in predicted value; E1 only.

research_question: Are E1 top-ranked candidates enriched for high measured GRWT100?
execution_evidence: query_evidence_oracle(candidate_id) called once each for IRIS_313.12254, IRIS_313.12242, IRIS_313.12344, IRIS_313.12228, IRIS_313.11094, IRIS_313.11623, IRIS_313.12063, IRIS_313.12352, IRIS_313.10061, IRIS_313.9464, IRIS_313.10569, IRIS_313.10294 (12 oracle queries, ordinals 1-12)
uncertainty: one historical measurement per line; no replication; single environment
conclusion: Measured GRWT100 falls monotonically with E1 rank: top-8 mean 3.90 g vs stratified controls mean 2.98 g. Direction of the model is confirmed by real measurements.
limitations: control at E1 rank 226 measured 3.4 g, above the rank-150 control (3.1 g) - local rank inversions exist

research_question: How well does the E1 ranking agree with measured GRWT100 on the 12 phenotyped lines?
execution_evidence: derived analysis (own computation) of ev-1 E1 ranks and ev-2 E3 measurements: Spearman of E1 predicted value vs measured GRWT100 over n=12 phenotyped lines

observed_result.note_sign: reported as +0.919 for (higher prediction -> higher measured); raw correlation of E1 rank number vs measurement was -0.919

uncertainty: n=12, 4 of which are stratified controls; wide confidence interval; single measurement per line
conclusion: E1 ranking agrees strongly with measured GRWT100 on this 12-line sample, consistent with the model card's held-out Spearman of ~0.45 (this sample is enriched at the extreme top, so it is not an unbiased estimate of pool-wide Spearman).
limitations: extreme-tail sample inflates observed rank correlation
not an unbiased pool-wide Spearman estimate

research_question: Round 2: extend the measured finalist pool over E1 ranks 9-26 and quantify E1-E3 agreement on all phenotyped lines
uncertainty: one historical measurement per line; no replication; single environment
conclusion: Round 2 reveals large individual deviations from E1 within the top 30: IRIS_313.12049 (E1 rank 23) = 2.0 g and IRIS_313.10448 (rank 24) = 2.1 g are the two lowest measured values, while IRIS_313.12349 (rank 14) = 4.7 g is the second highest. E1 ordering within the top-30 is therefore noisy at the individual-line level and the final top-10 must lean on measured values.
limitations: no repeated measures to separate measurement noise from model error

research_question: Post-revision E1-E3 agreement and measured top-10 selection over all 30 phenotyped lines
execution_evidence: derived analysis (own computation) of ev-1 E1 ranks and ev-2/ev-4 E3 measurements (n=30): Spearman of E1 rank number vs measured GRWT100 = -0.6413

observed_result.measured_quartile_boundary_bracket: between the control values 3.0 (E1 rank 400) and 3.4 (E1 rank 226); best estimate 3.3-3.5
observed_result.tie_break_note: four lines measured exactly 3.4 g (E1 ranks 9, 16, 18, 226); the two slots were given to the highest-E1-ranked of them (IRIS_313.12262 rank 9, IRIS_313.10653 rank 16)

uncertainty: n=30 of 904 lines (3.3%); boundary between 3.3 and 3.5 g, so the two 3.4 g finalists are near-boundary and carry the highest risk; single measurement per line
conclusion: E1 ranking is informative but noisy: Spearman 0.64 over the 30 phenotyped lines (top-enriched sample, not an unbiased pool estimate). The final top-10 selected on measured values spans 3.4-5.0 g, all at or above the bracketed quartile boundary.
limitations: measurement noise indistinguishable from model error
